rules: The established population target supplies residential demand, not a multiplier for industrial plants, fleets or exported goods. First seed production is in year8; the cap is reached in year200 and held throughyear220.

Customer scenarios retain their original initial audience, acceptance, competition and price assumptions. Annual real spending intensity, institutional contract counts and budget envelopes are tested at0,0.5,1percent growth throughyear200, then held; none is a forecast. Audience headcounts remain bounded at their scenario level.

Commercial supplier capture starts at5percent of the inherited reference portfolio, increases at an assumed4percent peryear, and is clipped to actual customer budgets. Provisioning must price and deliver that request; finance must separately establish that it can be funded. No population-linked replication or automatic unlimited demand is permitted.

A necessary cost screen rejects Earth-bound material offers below the inherited150USD2026/kg ground-service cost before counting revenue or production. Other positive-price offers are not certified profitable by that screen.

Service capacity starts with one kit. Additional kits are requested at most one peryear, with two-year lead and a10percent resident workforce planning allowance. The old20-kit ceiling is removed; the production consumer must still verify simultaneous jobs, physical installation and power.

Cultural and institutional exports retain variable partner/platform costs, acquisition, wages, fixed purchases and quoted capital/renewal allowances. Identified service facility costs must be credited against these allowances to avoid paying for the same assets twice.

Destination receipts purchase only stays. Beds, staff, utilities and materials are passed to provisioning. Travel access fares and passenger-safe fleet qualification remain separate; no visitor transport receipt is counted.

Research/compute/professional invoices share institutional budgets; mission research/fuel/support share a mission budget; culture/licensing/stays share a household budget. Internal computing and research are capacity uses rather than extra receipts.
